question: Should the unrelated `packages/net-policy` and `src/security` production changes remain in this Signal reverse-proxy fix after rebasing onto current `main`?
rationale: The central Signal change has direct real-world proof, but the branch includes additional behavior changes with different owners and validation needs; only a maintainer can determine whether they are intentional merge-result repairs or should be split.

options.title: Rebase and split unrelated changes
options.body: Keep the Signal URL fix and its tests in this PR, then submit any surviving IP-policy and security-audit work separately with focused rationale and proof.

options.title: Accept the combined scope
options.body: Retain the additional production changes only after reviewing their independent behavior and confirming they are required for this exact merge.

recommendation.title: Rebase and split unrelated changes
recommendation.body: Keep the Signal URL fix and its tests in this PR, then submit any surviving IP-policy and security-audit work separately with focused rationale and proof.
